items.headline: Manchester United beat Leeds 5-4 on penalties in pre-season friendly
items.summary: United drew 1-1 with Leeds at Croke Park in Dublin, winning 5-4 on penalties. Joshua Zirkzee scored; Marcus Rashford absent.

items.headline: Manchester United lose 4-2 to AC Milan in pre-season friendly
items.summary: United played AC Milan on 15 Aug 2026 in a friendly at Tarczyński Arena in Wrocław, losing 2-4.
